paragraphs: Mentioned at the end of Mishnah Eduyot: the Beit Tzerifa family was in Transjordan, and Ben Tzion forcibly excluded it.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The exclusion is reported about the family; “forcibly” preserves the source’s בזרוע.

The whole Torat Emet Mishnah Eduyot 8:7 paragraph explicitly places the Beit Tzerifa family in Transjordan and says Ben Tzion forcibly excluded it. The family object and force of בזרוע are supported, as in the existing note. No other family, legal material or identity is imported.
